2022 · Bachelor's Thesis

Reconfigurable Planetary System

A modular mechanical model of planetary motion where each planet's movements can be studied independently. The structure adapts based on the current planet and its satellite. Built with 3D-printed and laser-cut components controlled by an Arduino operating 4 motors. Designed for use in STEAM classrooms.

Autodesk InventorGear DesignServo Motors
2022 · Mechanical Design Detail

Planetary System — Gear & Motor Assembly

Exploded CAD view showing the ring gear, servo motor, encoder housing, and modular satellite bracket. Each sub-assembly was designed to be swapped out independently, enabling the system to represent different planets without full reconstruction.

ArduinoAutodesk InventorEmbedded SystemsFlame Detection
2019 · International Competition

Trinity College Firefighting Robot

Autonomous robot that navigates a maze-like arena, detects a live candle flame, and extinguishes it. Led structural CAD modeling and 3D printing of custom components. Implemented Arduino-based logic for sensor input, motor control, and flame detection. Creative engineering: a sealed bird water feeder was repurposed as the on-board water container — keeping electronics safe while enabling targeted extinguishing.

Data Lake on AWS — Insurance Platform

Designed and built a three-layer data lake (Raw → Staging → Curated) on AWS S3, integrating 6 data sources and processing 100+ GB using Delta Lake on Amazon EMR. Orchestrated pipelines with AWS Step Functions; built the Data Warehouse powering Power BI dashboards and actuarial analyses. Featured in an official AWS Brazil blog post as co-author.

Vitacheck — Parkinson's Early Detection Wearable

Sensor-based prototype using grip strength measurement and finger-tapping tests to detect early signs of Parkinson's disease. Integrated MEMS force and motion sensors with embedded hardware; developed the full real-time Python GUI for clinician and patient interaction. Designed with the clinical workflow at the center.
